value.rationale: Faro–Pavone (2026) specifically excludes intermediate d-bonacci iterates, motivating the sharp initial transition W_{d+1} for all d≥3. The theorem proves a wider arbitrary-length, arbitrary-alphabet marked-square class with exact three occurrence positions and lengths, explaining how a unique repeated endpoint digram isolates the only square-crossing factors. This is a natural complete local classification, not a numeric increment or a claim about all later iterates.
